data.name: DEAD_FARE
data.detailed_description:
Every passenger has a destination. Yours leads into a nightmare.

Your passengers aren't always alive.

Every night, strangers enter your taxi asking to be taken somewhere. Some disappear before the ride ends. Some know things they shouldn't. Others have been dead for years.

Every fare pulls you deeper into the mystery surrounding a cursed city where every decision changes someone's fate—including your own.

Features

  • Drive passengers whose stories refuse to end—even after death.

  • Every passenger can change the course of the story.

  • Multiple endings shaped by your choices.

  • Uncover why the city refuses to let anyone leave.

  • Experience every nightmare from behind the wheel of your taxi.

Will you survive your final shift?

Some passengers need to be saved.

Some should never reach their destination.

The hardest choice will be deciding which is which.

data.short_description: Drive the night shift through a cursed city where every passenger hides a secret—and some of them died long ago. Uncover the truth behind each fare, make irreversible choices, and decide who deserves to be saved before your final shift ends.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 2048 MB MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics (OpenGL 2.0 compatible)
  • Storage: 1000 MB MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard and mouse required.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4096 MB MB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics card recommended
  • Storage: 1000 MB MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for faster loading.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains psychological horror, disturbing imagery, frightening scenes, depictions of death, and references to crime. Players may encounter unsettling environments, corpses, themes of drowning, and occasional strong language. The game does not contain sexual content or explicit gore.
